episode_loop: observe title-neutral semantic state and living-collection ledger
enumerate the complete masked goal menu and require at least two executable choices
select one unused field-contract goal with the frozen learned goal manager at confidence at least 0.80
durably record the decision before controller input
execute only the selected existing bounded skill under hard in-flight action and frame limits
independently verify and durably pair exactly one outcome
reobserve state and rebuild the next complete menu
episode_pass_boundary: A pass is one fresh Red hierarchical composition episode only. It grants no new authority and permits only a separately frozen design for the already named matched open Crystal development comparison; it does not authorize that comparison.
preflight_pass_boundary: A preflight pass establishes only that one exact published runner and action-free admitted root identity satisfy the engineering boundary. It freezes an unclaimed identity for separate authorization and is not gameplay, an episode result, learned progress, authority, or transfer evidence.

replacement_rationale.review_consensus: Use only already co-located and independently verified field skills; do not create a route or composite skill to rescue V1.

root_admission_boundary: Action-free admission can certify only freshness, nonsealed Red identity, initial state integrity, exact source and model identity, and the initial field-contract menu. Later menus, model confidence, three distinct selections, acquisition, and replanning remain execution-time falsifiers.
stop_rule: Fail and durably close the exact root on low confidence, a singleton menu, fixed dispatch, binding or verifier failure, missing durable join, repeated or out-of-contract goal selection, absent required-specimen acquisition, collection regression or undeclared specimen loss, unchanged policy context, no menu change, bound exhaustion, or protected access. Do not retry or patch that root into compliance.
title_role: Red curriculum composition; not a transfer, promotion, sealed, or completion test
